mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT c.no,c.title,m.name AS instructor, c.star, c.student_count, c.thumbnail,c.images FROM Course c JOIN member m ON c.instructor_no=m.member_id WHERE thumbnail IS NOT NULL AND content IS NOT NULL AND images IS NOT NULL ORDER BY no DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <=10

SELECT p_c.no, p_c.title, p_c.instructor_no, m.name AS instructor, p_c.star, p_c.student_count, p_c.pay_price, p_c.regular_price, p_c.thumbnail, p_c.images, t.no AS tech_no, t.tech AS tech_name, t.category FROM ( SELECT c.* FROM Course c WHERE c.thumbnail IS NOT NULL AND c.content IS NOT NULL AND c.images IS NOT NULL
AND c.no IN ( SELECT ctm.course_no FROM course_tech_mapping ctm JOIN tech_stack st ON ctm.tech_no=st.no WHERE st.category IN
#{category}
)
AND c.title LIKE '%'||#{fd}||'%'
ORDER BY
star DESC, no DESC pay_price ASC, no DESC pay_price DESC, no DESC no DESC
OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 15 ROWS ONLY ) p_c JOIN member m ON p_c.instructor_no=m.member_id LEFT JOIN course_tech_mapping ctm ON p_c.no=ctm.course_no LEFT JOIN tech_stack t ON ctm.tech_no=t.no ORDER BY
p_c.star DESC, p_c.no DESC p_c.pay_price ASC, p_c.no DESC p_c.pay_price DESC, p_c.no DESC p_c.no DESC
SELECT DISTINCT category FROM tech_stack ORDER BY category

SELECT c.no, c.title, c.instructor_no, m.name AS instructor, c.star, c.student_count, c.pay_price, c.regular_price, c.thumbnail, c.images, c.content,t.no AS tech_no, t.tech AS tech_name, t.category FROM Course c LEFT JOIN member m ON c.instructor_no=m.member_id LEFT JOIN course_tech_mapping ctm ON c.no=ctm.course_no LEFT JOIN tech_stack t ON ctm.tech_no=t.no WHERE c.no=#{no}
